female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-institutional-partner-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster.
female-institutional-partner-faster.body: Pitches from women that mention specific institutional partners, such as NWTF, are associated with increased funding speed.

female-family-responsibilities-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention family members or household responsibilities fund more slowly.
female-family-responsibilities-slower.body: Pitches from women that reference family responsibilities or household duties are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-dreams-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their dreams or aspirations fund faster.
female-dreams-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference their dreams or future aspirations are associated with increased funding speed.

community-benefit-faster-general.body: Pitches that mention benefits to the local community or neighbors may fund faster regardless of gender.

female-photo-explanation-slower.body: Female borrowers who include a note explaining their photo may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-promise-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly promise to repay the loan promptly may fund faster.

female-education-goal-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan will contribute to children's education may fund faster.

female-pig-fattening-faster.body: Female borrowers mentioning a pig fattening business may fund faster.

female-general-store-slower.body: Female borrowers mentioning a general store business may fund more slowly.

female-political-instability-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe fleeing political instability, such as in South Sudan, may fund faster.

female-loan-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention business duration or prior loan history may fund more slowly.

female-inventory-lists-faster.body: Female borrowers who include specific lists of inventory items to be purchased may fund faster.

female-inventory-lists-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed lists of inventory items may fund more slowly.
female-inventory-lists-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific inventory lists accelerate funding

female-template-phrasing-slower.title: Female borrowers who use nearly identical template phrasing in their pitches may fund more slowly.
female-template-phrasing-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that faster pitches use identical phrasing regarding education and gratitude

female-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age may fund faster.
female-age-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning age is associated with slower pitches

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly thank lenders in their pitches may fund faster.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that gratitude appears in slower pitches

female-province-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their specific province, such as Iloilo, may fund faster.
female-province-mention-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new business-type observations

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age may fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new business-type observations

female-local-currency-faster.title: Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.
female-local-currency-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that local currency mention is associated with slower funding

female-partner-loan-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention previous loans or borrowing history may fund faster.
female-partner-loan-history-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning previous loans from NWTF is associated with slower funding

female-inventory-lists-slower-v2.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed lists of inventory items may fund more slowly.
female-inventory-lists-slower-v2.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that inventory lists are associated with faster funding

female-business-history-longer-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify a longer duration of business operation may fund faster.
female-business-history-longer-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that business duration and loan history are associated with slower funding
